name: agentic-primitives-home
doctrine: Installing a component never installs authority (spec 398 D07): every item renders a contract's projections and posts to the app's A2A boundary; a mandate is signed where mandates are signed.

items.name: state-pill
items.title: State pill
items.description: One state vocabulary, everywhere (398 §5.1): the projected word for a run, task, endeavor, trigger or step, with effect-uncertain as its own tone.

meta.authority: none — renders a contract's projections and posts only to the app's /a2a boundary; carries no key, no grant, no verb (398 D07)

items.name: basis-line
items.title: Basis line
items.description: Acting as · in · basis (custody | membership grant | delegation in hand | none) · what this act needs (398 §4.4). A role name is never a basis.

meta.example: <BasisLine needs="send money as alice2.treasury, this request only" />
meta.authority: none — renders a contract's projections and posts only to the app's /a2a boundary; carries no key, no grant, no verb (398 D07)

items.name: work-item-card
items.title: Work item
items.description: The accountable work item (398 §4.3): goal · owner · executors · status · conversation · artifacts · acceptance · cost — absent said absent.

meta.authority: none — renders a contract's projections and posts only to the app's /a2a boundary; carries no key, no grant, no verb (398 D07)

items.name: run-controls
items.title: Run controls (cancel)
items.description: Pause · cancel · revoke · undo are four things (398 §5.3): the cancel control, saying what it is not.

meta.authority: none — renders a contract's projections and posts only to the app's /a2a boundary; carries no key, no grant, no verb (398 D07)

items.name: run-inspector
items.title: Run inspector
items.description: Artifact-first (398 §5.2): outcome → artifacts → decisions → plan and per-step authority → execution detail → provenance; the retry affordance from the contract's idempotency.

meta.authority: none — renders a contract's projections and posts only to the app's /a2a boundary; carries no key, no grant, no verb (398 D07)

items.name: attention-bar
items.title: Attention groups
items.description: What needs you, pinned in the inbox rail (398 §5.5): needs you (decisions + questions, open) · waiting · finished, folded; one card per object, one action set; unread is a filter on the conversations, never a group. Six filters stay the model.

meta.example: <AttentionGroups inputs={inputs} token={t} addressee={me} onCanceled={drop} renderCaseActions={actionsFor} onOpenDm={open} onOpenCase={openCase} />
meta.authority: none — renders a contract's projections and posts only to the app's /a2a boundary; carries no key, no grant, no verb (398 D07)

items.name: fleet-lines
items.title: Fleet boundary
items.description: M06 (398 §4.4): where an agent runs · what it may spend · what it holds — three lines, not an avatar.

meta.authority: none — renders a contract's projections and posts only to the app's /a2a boundary; carries no key, no grant, no verb (398 D07)

items.name: roster
items.title: Roster
items.description: Per participant (398 §4.5): type · sponsor · responsibility · permissions in words · active work (§12-honest).

meta.authority: none — renders a contract's projections and posts only to the app's /a2a boundary; carries no key, no grant, no verb (398 D07)

items.name: save-as-recipe
items.title: Save as recipe
items.description: A completed run as a draft SKILL.md in the Library (398 APUX-034): the runtime drafts (plan as steps, parties as roles, no key can reach it), the person saves; the draft says authority is requested anew.

meta.authority: none — renders a contract's projections and posts only to the app's /a2a boundary; carries no key, no grant, no verb (398 D07)

items.name: artifact-identity
items.title: Artifact identity
items.description: Version · author · sources · scope · work item · access method (owned locally | live remote | authorized replica | derived copy); share, publish, replicate as three acts (398 §6.2).

meta.example: const id = artifactIdentity(artifact, { sa: owner, vaultLabel: 'Person vault' }, publishable);
meta.authority: none — renders a contract's projections and posts only to the app's /a2a boundary; carries no key, no grant, no verb (398 D07)
